name: Parabolic SAR EA
summary: This EA uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to generate trend-following trading signals. It opens buy positions when the SAR dots flip below the price and sell positions when they flip above. The strategy is a classic trend-following system that rides sustained directional moves while using the SAR as both entry and trailing stop mechanism.
summary_zh: 该EA使用抛物线SAR指标生成趋势跟踪交易信号。当SAR点翻转到价格下方时开多仓，翻转到上方时开空仓。这是一个经典的趋势跟踪系统，利用SAR作为入场和追踪止损机制来捕捉持续的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于抛物线SAR指标构建趋势跟踪策略，核心概念是利用SAR指标的方向翻转作为趋势转换信号。入场条件为：当SAR点从价格上方翻转到下方时做多，从下方翻转到上方时做空。出场条件同样依赖SAR指标的再次翻转，即持仓方向与SAR信号相反时平仓，SAR本身起到追踪止损的作用。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的仓位计算方式，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理上，该策略依赖SAR的加速因子来动态调整止损距离，随着趋势发展止损会逐步靠近价格，实现利润保护。然而，SAR指标在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号，导致连续止损，这是该策略的主要弱点。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA builds a trend-following strategy around the Parabolic SAR indicator, with the core concept of using SAR dot flips as trend reversal signals. Entry conditions are: go long when SAR dots flip from above price to below, and go short when they flip from below to above. Exit conditions also rely on SAR flip signals, closing positions when the SAR reverses against the held direction, effectively using SAR as a trailing stop mechanism. Position sizing typically uses fixed lots or an equity-proportional approach depending on parameter configuration. Money management leverages the SAR's acceleration factor to dynamically adjust stop-loss distance, progressively tightening the stop as the trend advances to protect profits. However, the Parabolic SAR indicator is prone to generating frequent false signals in ranging or choppy markets, leading to consecutive stop-outs, which is the strategy's primary weakness.

parameters.name: SAR_Step
parameters.description: SAR加速因子步长，控制SAR接近价格的速度
parameters.description_en: SAR acceleration factor step, controls SAR approach speed

parameters.name: SAR_Maximum
parameters.description: SAR加速因子最大值，限制SAR追踪的紧密程度
parameters.description_en: SAR acceleration factor maximum, limits tracking tightness

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示使用SAR作为止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示使用SAR翻转作为止盈
parameters.description_en: Overall take profit target in points

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于经典SAR指标，易于理解和验证
SAR指标自带追踪止损功能，能随着趋势发展逐步锁定利润
趋势行情中表现优秀，能够捕捉大段趋势利润
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on the classic SAR indicator, easy to understand and verify
Built-in trailing stop functionality via SAR, progressively locking in profits as the trend develops
Excellent performance in trending markets, capable of capturing large trend moves
cons: 震荡行情中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏额外的趋势确认过滤器，仅依赖单一指标容易误判
SAR加速因子参数对表现影响极大，不同品种需要不同优化参数
缺少明确的止损和止盈设置选项，风险控制不够灵活
cons_en: Generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks additional trend confirmation filters, relying on a single indicator increases misjudgment risk
SAR acceleration factor parameters heavily impact performance, requiring different optimization per instrument
Lacks explicit stop-loss and take-profit options, risk control is not flexible enough
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），在震荡行情中减少虚假信号
加入动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户风险比例调整手数，提升资金管理能力
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as ADX or moving average direction) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage to improve money management

risk_points: 单一SAR指标在震荡市中会产生连续虚假信号导致多次止损
缺少额外的止损机制，若SAR计算异常可能造成较大亏损
risk_points_en: Single SAR indicator generates consecutive false signals in ranging markets causing multiple stop-outs
Lacks additional stop-loss mechanism; SAR calculation anomalies could cause significant losses
